title: {Syn} 0.999... Equals 1 Without a Trick
content:
The decimal 0.999... is exactly equal to 1 in the real numbers. One quick reason: 1/3 equals 0.333..., so 3 times 1/3 equals 0.999..., which is 1.

The discomfort usually comes from treating an infinite decimal as if it stops just before 1. It does not stop.

Why it matters: math facts keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
